title: Beale Paper No. 1 (The Beale Papers, Lynchburg, 1885)

documents.shelfmark: The Beale Papers (1885 pamphlet), pp. 20-22, via Wikisource

system.summary: Numbers 1-2906 presented as a book cipher; judged a fabrication, chosen off the numbered Declaration of Independence without encoding English.
system.sibling_key: Beale Paper No. 2 reads with the pamphlet's numbered Declaration (positive control); does not read B1.
system.notes: Gillogly's alphabetic strings reproduce (positions 187-206); DOI-initial histogram of B1 matches random picks (z -1.0).

tools: FFT book-cipher offset scan with drift bands (bookcipher.py)

solution.what: Scan finds B2's key (Declaration) in Gutenberg #1, #300 and mid-book in #1866.
Book-cipher scan over 4,254 Gutenberg books and Internet Archive candidates (Pike, Lewis & Clark, Jefferson, Webb), several keying modes.
DOI-keyed decode of B1 as a second-layer simple substitution scores as a shuffled control.
Repeated-pair language signature (B1 z -0.3) and DOI-initial histogram (z -1.0) show no encoded language.

outcome.notes: Called a fabrication; corpus scan stopped after 3 of 37 shards.
